educationalGoal: Using the basic academic skills that students have learned in this Department of Mechanical Engineering, students acquire the ability to discover and solve different technical problems in mechanical engineering-related fields by themselves, in order to create new technologies that are necessary for researching, developing, designing and manufacturing useful and high-quality products. Students will also learn the importance of collaboration with society, especially the local community.
advice:
The educational aim of the Department of Mechanical Engineering is to develop mechanical engineers who acquire basic knowledge of mechanical engineering, can design application technology, manufacturing new materials, and their processing methods, and also respond technology related to the environment and energy.

PD III is the final subject of the department, and in order to realize the educational goals of the department, the emphasis is placed on developing the ability to set up proper models to describe phenomena, to analyze and solve the problems using the models, and to develop the ability to make engineering evaluations based on the obtained results. In practice, the students check the project proposals prepared by the teachers in the individual laboratories and in the specialist seminars, review them if necessary, and carry out the process of problem finding and solving according to the content of the proposals.

Students will also understand the objectives of the subject and the outline and achievement goals based on the syllabus. It is important that student will understand which part of the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering this subject is responsible for and the specific level of the achievement.

This laboratory mainly approach the subjects concerning high temperature oxidation of metals. These subjects are related real industrial situation.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process accurately, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile the intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present and discuss its content. Complete the final report, present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board, and discuss its content.
(3) If necessary, design and manufacture your own experimental devices, and also evaluate the performance of the product.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the purpose of your project theme and the advancement process, and achieve the established annual goal. In addition, the process can be reported in the Design Project Activity Support System.
(2) Compile intermediate results for the project into the interim report, and present its content. Complete the final report and present it to the Design Project III Public Presentation Review Board.
 (3) Design and manufacture your own experimental devices if necessary.

lessons.content:
Submitted proposal in the previous
semester is revised as necessary.

Previous research is investigated
through PD reports and literature
surveys. A research plan is
developed and experiments and
surveys are carried out.

Mid-term presentation is conducted
at the end of first semester.

Pre-print report is compiled and
submitted in July.
Final report is submitted in February.

The researched content is presented
at the PD public reviewing in
February.
Final report is uploaded in February.

PD III is the final subject of the department, and in order to realize the educational goals of the department, the emphasis is placed on developing the ability to set up proper models to describe phenomena, to analyze and solve the problems using the models, and to develop the ability to make engineering evaluations based on the obtained results. In practice, the students check the project proposals prepared by the teachers in the individual laboratories and in the specialist seminars, review them if necessary, and carry out the process of problem finding and solving according to the content of the proposals.

It is important that student will understand which part of the educational objectives of the Department of Mechanical Engineering this subject is responsible for and the specific level of the achievement.
